A locator marks position only — marker size does not encode a value. Coordinates are each organisation's own Wikidata point, not a street address. 9 of the 11 sit within 1.3 km of their common centre; 2 stand apart from that cluster: the World Economic Forum 4.2 km east and the International Civil Defence Organisation 4.0 km south, both labelled on the map. The International Labour Organization and the International Social Security Association are 13 m apart, so at the opening view they share one marker's worth of space: zoom in to separate them, and to read the names the frame has no room for.
